text: dsh-drop-in 是一个面向 DSH Web 聊天界面的文件拖入插件。它在输入框上方显示可移除的文件栏，也能在光标处插入原生文件引用；发送后，文件路径随消息提供，并在用户消息气泡中显示为文件卡片。主要功能包括拖放和粘贴文件、按会话整理待发送文件、复制无路径文件到工作区，以及通过 dropped_files 工具查询未发送文件。适合需要把本机文件交给 DSH 会话处理的用户。Desktop 绝对路径需要额外安装 preload 路径桥。

dsh-drop-in adds file drop and paste to DSH Web chat. Files appear as chips or inline references, travel with submitted messages, and render as file cards. The dropped_files tool lists pending files. Pathless files can be copied into the session workspace. Desktop needs a preload bridge for paths.
我想把电脑里的文件直接拖进 DSH 对话里。
能不能把粘贴的图片或文件一起发给助手？
让聊天消息里的本地文件显示成容易识别的卡片。
我需要在输入文字中间插入一个文件引用。
How can I attach a local file by dragging it into chat?
I want pasted files to go along with my message to the assistant.
Show a readable file card for references included in a chat message.
Let me place a file reference at the current cursor position.
dsh-drop-in 的功能「拖放和粘贴文件」：将文件拖进聊天页，或在输入框粘贴文件；光标可用时插入引用，否则显示在文件栏中。
dsh-drop-in 的功能「随消息发送文件」：提交时将文件引用或待发送文件块附加到草稿，包含可用的路径信息；提交后清空文件栏。
dsh-drop-in 的功能「文件卡片渲染」：消息中的文件引用会显示名称、类型和路径状态；图片附件可加载为聊天气泡中的预览。
dsh-drop-in 的功能「查询未发送文件」：助手调用 dropped_files 工具即可列出当前会话登记的文件名称、路径、大小和状态。
dsh-drop-in 的功能「无路径文件落盘」：缺少本机路径时，文本文件或粘贴的二进制可复制到会话工作区的 .dsh-drops 目录。
dsh-drop-in 使用前须知：DSH Desktop 中取得拖入文件的绝对路径依赖 preload 桥；需运行配套注入器，桌面更新后可能需要重新安装。
dsh-drop-in 使用前须知：浏览器或无路径桥的场景会把无路径文本文件及粘贴二进制写入会话工作区的 .dsh-drops/<sessionId>/。

dsh-drop-in README · dsh-drop-in：Drag files from your system file manager straight into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
Files appear as a chip bar above the input box, or — with the composer focused — as a
**native reference bubble** (file pill) embedded inline in the text you are typing; they
are sent along with your message (including their **absolute paths**), and render as
file cards inside the user bubble. The agent reads the real file paths — no upload, no
content copy (plain-browser fallback copies small files into the workspace).

dsh-drop-in README · Features：- 📎 Drag in **any file/folder** (images are treated as files — the official image-drop overlay no longer steals the drag)
- 🫧 **Inline file bubble**: dropped/pasted files are inserted at the caret as a native reference pill (works mid-text); the pill shows **`TYPE name`** (e.g. `LNK 坚果云.lnk` — the type survives name clipping, full name on hover)
- 📤 **Path on send**: the pill expands to a reference carrying the **absolute path** (`@[filename](absolute-path)`); the chat bubble renders it as a file card with a type badge — the agent can read the file straight from the path
- 🔀 Messages sent while the agent is running ("interrupt-free") render the same file cards
- 🖼️ **Clipboard paste**: pasting an image/file into the composer goes through the same pipeline instead of the native image-attachment rail; pasted binaries are persisted (base64) under `.dsh-drops/<sessionId>/`
- 🚀 Chip bar above the input: icon + name + size + path status, removable (×), deduplicated by path
- ✔️ Enter / Ctrl+Enter / the send button are all covered; chips clear automatically after sending
- 🔍 A `dropped_files` tool lets the agent list still-unsent dropped files
- 🖥️ Under DSH

dsh-drop-in README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lbl61/dsh-drop-in/archive/refs/tags/v1.4.0.tar.gz
```

Manual (bundle) install:
1. Extract `dsh-drop-in` into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-drop-in/`
2. Add `"dsh-drop-in"` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`
3. Restart `dsh web` (DSH Desktop: quit fully and reopen, or run `window.dshDesktop.restartService()` in DevTools)

dsh-drop-in README · DSH Desktop: enable absolute paths (required for path features)：```sh
node scripts/install-preload-bridge.mjs      # auto-locates DSH Desktop
node scripts/install-preload-bridge.mjs --dry-run   # check only
node scripts/install-preload-bridge.mjs --restore   # undo (byte-identical)
```

Then fully quit and reopen DSH Desktop. Without it, chips still appear but read
"无法读取路径" (no path) and the agent cannot read the files. See
[preload-bridge.md](preload-bridge.md).

text:
dsh-drop-in README · Usage：1. Drag files from Explorer into the chat page (or paste an image/file into the composer)
2. Composer focused → files are inserted at the caret as **native reference bubbles** (file pills), mid-text allowed; otherwise they appear in the chip bar above the input
3. Type your message and send (Enter / Ctrl+Enter / the send button all work; "interrupt-free" sending while the agent runs is supported too)
4. The bubble shows file cards — the agent receives the absolute path (`@[name](path)` or the `📎 拖入文件` block) and can read the files

dsh-drop-in README · How it works：- The client half intercepts file drags in the capture phase (the official image-upload flow never steals the events), keeps a per-session chip bar (`conversation.input.dock`), renders user bubbles with file cards (`conversation.chat.node` `user`/`steering` keys), and stitches the `📎 拖入文件` block into the draft before submit (Enter, Ctrl+Enter, and the send button are all covered); with the composer focused it inserts **native reference bubbles** via the `slash/input-insert-reference` scoped event (U+FFFC occurrences rendered by the composer backdrop) and the registered `inputTriggers` codec serializes them to `@[filename](absolute-path)` on submit
- The host half keeps the per-session file registry behind the `dropped_files` tool, writes fallback text copies to `.dsh-drops/<sessionId>/`, and persists pasted binaries via the `file-copy` route (base64, with an explicit workspace-write sandbox policy rooted at the session cwd)
- Absolute paths under DSH Desktop rely on the preload bridge (see [preload-bridge.md](preload-bridge.md)): Electron ≥ 32 removed `File.path`

dsh-drop-in README · Configuration：| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `enabled` | Master switch (Settings → 文件拖入). When off, drag/paste falls back to built-in behavior. |

dsh-drop-in README · Uninstall：1. Remove `dsh-drop-in` from the `dsh.profile.bundles` array in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`
2. Delete `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-drop-in/`
3. Restart `dsh web`
